agent1.reason: A1 validates best_of_sets but its Elo expectation and probability use rating and surface only.

agent2.reason: The serve-based Markov engine resolves games, tiebreaks, sets and the match in one model; changing the scoring rule changes match length once.

conclusion: Agent 1 is inherently format-insensitive by design, not because history is absent.
Agent 2 is format-sensitive only through its single Markov scoring-rule conversion.
Manager is a probability aggregator and does not duplicate the Agent 2 conversion.
Correcting AO history from BO3 to BO5 cannot move Agent 1 because A1 never reads the value in its probability path.

independent_set_reference.note: Mathematical reference only, not an Agent implementation requirement.

manager.reason: Manager takes the unweighted mean of active agent probabilities and applies no match-format conversion.
